in_sanskrit.name: भार्गविका
in_sanskrit.meaning: विद्या समप्रदायिका भार्गवे, विद्या रूपेण भार्गवे

in_marathi.name: Bhargvika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Dedicated to Bhargava
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhargvika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Bhargava’, which refers to the sage Bhargava or the God Bharga. Bhargava is a title given to sages, seers, and poets, who were believed to have mastered the Vedas. This name signifies dedication and devotion to the wisdom of the Vedas and the gods.
